priority_review.rationale: Carrington is a 2021 NEA Jazz Master with a singular rhythmic identity, and Social Science is not a repertory vehicle: its work explicitly combines contemporary improvisation with R&B, indie rock and hip-hop while engaging social-justice themes. Keystone's authorized listing frames these dates as a release celebration for the new Trip the Night Fantastic, giving the engagement a concrete current artistic context. This is worth a dedicated DMV-to-Baltimore drive, while remaining below S+ because it is a two-night album-release engagement rather than a singular premiere, farewell or historically unique one-off.

events.factual_description: Keystone Korner Baltimore and its authorized InstantSeats listings confirm Terri Lyne Carrington + Social Science on Friday and Saturday, December 18-19, 2026, with 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets on both nights. InstantSeats describes the engagement as a release celebration for the ensemble's 2026 album Trip the Night Fantastic. Carrington's official project page describes the album as a 13-track collection connecting jazz and collaboration to themes including gender identity, climate justice and the abolition of punitive systems. The National Endowment for the Arts identifies Carrington as a 2021 NEA Jazz Master. Specific Social Science personnel for the Baltimore engagement were not published in the authoritative listings checked in this pass and are therefore not inferred.

en.why_it_matters: Terri Lyne Carrington is a living master whose identity is inseparable from rhythm, production and the way she uses ensemble music to push jazz outward. Social Science is especially relevant to Listening Notes because the band treats improvisation, groove, R&B, hip-hop and social inquiry as one language rather than adjacent genres. These Baltimore dates are tied to the new Trip the Night Fantastic instead of a retrospective set, so the reason to go is the current work: a major drummer-composer still expanding the form in a small room.
en.trip_verdict: S. Protect one of the four sets. Worth a dedicated DMV-to-Baltimore drive for a living NEA Jazz Master, a rhythm-first ensemble and a genuinely current album-release context. It stays below S+ because this is a two-night release engagement rather than a unique premiere, farewell or once-only historical event.

es.why_it_matters: Terri Lyne Carrington es una maestra viva cuya identidad está amarrada al ritmo, la producción y a una manera de empujar el jazz hacia afuera desde el ensamble. Social Science encaja especialmente bien en Listening Notes porque trata improvisación, groove, R&B, hip-hop y reflexión social como un solo lenguaje, no como géneros pegados uno junto al otro. Estas fechas de Baltimore están ligadas al nuevo Trip the Night Fantastic, no a una retrospectiva: la razón para ir es escuchar obra actual de una baterista-compositora mayor que todavía está expandiendo la forma en una sala pequeña.
es.trip_verdict: S. Hay que proteger uno de los cuatro sets. Sí vale un viaje dedicado DMV→Baltimore por una NEA Jazz Master viva, un ensamble centrado en ritmo y groove y un contexto real de lanzamiento de obra nueva. Se queda debajo de S+ porque son dos noches de presentación de disco, no un estreno único, despedida o acontecimiento histórico irrepetible.
